name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action.
a11y: role="alertdialog" with a name from the title and a description.
Focus moves to the Cancel button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape cancels; focus is trapped; the page behind is inert.
Clicking the overlay does not close it.

source.content: export {AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel} from './alert-dialog';
